State of Mind-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

State of Mind marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe emotion and mood logging — not a literal paste of US marketing:

心情状态 vs 情绪记录 vs 心理状态

US pages use "State of Mind", "Mood logging", or "Emotion tracking." China storefront copy often uses 心情状态 for the Health State of Mind category and mood status summaries, 情绪记录 when gallery frames show logged emotion entries and mood history lists, and 心理状态 when emotional wellbeing trend charts and analytics dashboards dominate. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Momentary mood vs daily mood

Momentary mood check-ins (此刻心情 / 情绪) capture how you feel right now — not end-of-day daily mood recap cards (每日心情 / 心情). When your gallery shows "How are you feeling?" emotion wheels, caption lines use 情绪 or 此刻心情 — not 每日心情 unless the frame shows a daily summary card.

State of Mind vs Mindfulness vs Journal

State of Mind (心情状态 / 情绪记录) is Apple Health emotion and mood logging inside the Health app — not Mindfulness meditation libraries (正念 / 冥想), not Breathe inhale-exhale practice (呼吸), and not Apple Journal long-form diary entries (日记). Reflect prompts inside Mindfulness are meditation-adjacent reflection — not Health State of Mind category browsing unless your gallery actually shows Health mood logging UI.

State of Mind vs Symptoms vs Clinical Notes

Emotional mood logging (心情状态) differs from physical symptom pickers for headache, cough, and pain (症状 / 症状记录) and from Clinical Notes provider documents (临床笔记 / 就诊记录). Mood picker frames need 情绪 or 心情状态 language — not 症状 on dedicated emotion logging screenshots. Symptom frames belong on the Symptoms listing guide; clinical document frames belong on the Clinical Notes listing guide.

State of Mind vs Water Intake, Sleep, and Fitness

Mood logging dashboards belong here. Water cup counters and hydration goals (饮水 / 喝水) belong on the Water Intake guide. Sleep Schedule cards and sleep stages (睡眠) belong on the Sleep guide. Activity rings and workout sessions (健身 / 活动闭环) belong on the Fitness guide — mention only as contrast when your English page honestly shows both on separate labeled screenshots.
